wiki.title: Jodi Habush Sinykin
wiki.extract: Jodi Habush Sinykin (born Jodi Lynn Habush; May 1967) is an American lawyer and Democratic politician from Milwaukee County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 8th Senate district since 2025.
